# Bolivia OpenSourceRail Campaign

National outreach package covering **1 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Bolivia ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Bolivia national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Bolivia public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Bolivia in the United Kingdom — economic section
